audit.why: TRICKY at 7/10 fits a 46.15% win rate and a lane that is Lillia's from 2 to 6 and Yone's from first item onward, which is exactly what the content says.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 was credited to Lillia and Levels 3 and 4-5 to Yone, contradicting the whys on those rows.
audit.why: whys[0] 'Yone is an even level-1 and so are you'; whys[2] 'every step he takes at you feeds the DoT'; whys[3] 'the lane evens out'. Packet levelChart reads Skill, Lillia, Lillia, Skill, Lillia, Yone, Yone.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 2 and 3 aligned in both layers with matching ratings, as one group. Rows 4, 5 and 6 already agreed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Fate Sealed is called a knock-up in three places. It is a pull. The full layer also never states the one thing that makes Soul Unbound punishable.
audit.why: Riot text for Fate Sealed: 'Yone blinks behind the last champion in a line with a slash so powerful it pulls all enemies hit towards him' — 120/100/80s, 1000 range, no knock-up. The knock-up in his kit is Mortal Steel at 2 stacks of Gathering Storm, on a 4s cooldown. Soul Unbound is 22/19/16/13/10s and ends with his spirit 'forced back to his body' — so kiting away from where he left the body is what survives it, and that is the concrete instruction the page was missing. Spirit Cleave is 14s at 700 range and shields him for more per champion hit.
audit.corrected: Pull vs knock-up fixed, the snap-back-to-body rule stated with the cooldown, the two-stack condition on his dash stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'take the fifteen-second invitation' — an invented cooldown; the packet also flagged zero sequencing cues on this page.
audit.why: Nothing in Yone's kit is fifteen seconds. Soul Unbound is 10-22s, Spirit Cleave 14s, Mortal Steel 4s, Fate Sealed 80-120s.
audit.corrected: Replaced with the real Spirit Cleave window, and full cooldowns written into breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.why: The packet's suspectNames entry for 'Hold Lilting Lullaby' in wants.you[1] is a false positive — Lilting Lullaby is Lillia's real R name in her own kit file. No edit made.

edits.before: Q's outer ring on his last-hits plus the passive speed means he literally cannot touch you at level 1.
edits.after: Level 1 is even — you have one ability each, so last-hit at Q range and stay out of his cleave cone.

edits.before: - Yone Soul Unbound: matchup-defining — His burst window — survive it and punish the body he snaps back to. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget passive move speed for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Soul Unbound: 22/19/16/13/10s — when it ends his spirit is yanked back to his body, so kite away from where he left it. - Spirit Cleave is 14s and shields him. - Fate Sealed, 120/100/80s, pulls you to him; it is not a knock-up.

edits.before: Track Yone’s Soul Unbound: His burst window — survive it and punish the body he snaps back to. It’s down or you don’t go.
edits.after: Soul Unbound, 10-22s: he is dragged back to his body when it ends — kite away from that spot and survive the snap.

edits.before: His burst window — survive it and punish the body he snaps back to. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: Soul Unbound is 22s at rank 1, and while it is down his only gap-close is the two-stack Mortal Steel dash.

edits.before: Yone burns Soul Unbound on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Spirit Cleave is 14s and shields him — trade after the cleave, never into it.

edits.before: That’s Yone’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.
edits.after: Mortal Steel only dashes and knocks up at 2 stacks — count his hits.

edits.before: His double-dash Q and R knockup pin you mid-kite and you have no defensive button — he out-scales the kite war, so close before late.
edits.after: His two-stack Q dash and the Fate Sealed pull drag you out of the kite with no defensive button — close it out before late.

edits.before: His double-dash Q gap-close plus R knockup pins you mid-kite — one combo deletes you since you have no defensive button.
edits.after: His two-stack Q dash plus a Fate Sealed pull drags you back into melee — one combo deletes you with no defensive button.

edits.before: Catch you mid-kite with R knockup or his E rewind reset to commit a lethal all-in
edits.after: Catch you mid-kite with the Fate Sealed pull, then snap back on Soul Unbound

notes: Fate Sealed being a pull rather than a knock-up matters beyond wording: it means Yone has no self-setup for a knock-up-dependent ally ult from his R, and it means the displacement drags you toward him rather than away, which is the opposite of how the old text read. Soul Unbound's return-to-body is now the actionable line on the page; his E range in the kit file is listed as 25000, which is a data artefact for a self-cast, so no range was quoted.
